Show the difference between copying a list and referencing it.

Supplied answer
original = [1, 2, 3]
reference = original # SAME list, two names
reference.append(4)
print(original) # [1, 2, 3, 4] -> changed!
copy_list = original.copy() # or list(original) / original[:]
copy_list.append(5)
print(original) # [1, 2, 3, 4] -> safe
Note: Assignment does not copy a list, it only creates another name for the same object.
